facts.fact: The Harvard CAS field report says Rwanda's Ministry of Education runs the web-based SDMS, with which annual education statistics are now compiled in a fraction of the time.
The report says, from a headteacher, that every student is assigned a unique ID in the SDMS, which tracks enrolment and attendance per student, with school compliance up from 40% to 70-80%.
The report says, from a headteacher, that the SDMS integrates with the national identity system, though it does not yet fully connect with other management systems.
